title: Refresh MCP curated tool set for the expanded CLI surface
description:
The MCP server auto-generates tools from the CLI schema and its integration test bounds the curated set below 50; the maintenance batch grew the surface to 68 generated tools, so the suite fails.

## Background

New commands from the batch (issue status/children/progress, query count/divergence, config get, gate findings view, graph tree, migrate, export --full) enter the generated tool set. The curated bound exists to keep the MCP surface intentional, so the fix is a deliberate re-curation, not only a raised number.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The curated tool list explicitly includes or excludes each newly generated command with a one-line rationale in the test or its fixture.
- [hard] REQ-02: mcp-server npm test passes.
- [hard] REQ-03: The tool-count bound reflects the curated set with documented headroom.
